answer: In PoA, every identity escrows bonded collateral, while signatures, timing, and control evidence link coordinated behavior. If k identities equivocate on conflicting votes, penalties scale quadratically as O(k^2), so a sybil swarm costs more than independent faults. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier applies to capital loss, and asymmetric depreciation limits recovery; marble, ivory, and opal aliases provide no escape from correlated slashing.
